company.shortDescription: Baserun is a developer of a testing platform that helps developers ship large language models (LLMs) apps.
company.description: Baserun is a developer of a testing platform that helps developers ship large language models (LLMs) apps. Its platform provides various features, including a prompt playground, end-to-end tests, and a visualization dashboard that allows developers to test their apps, identify and fix bugs, and ensure that their apps work as expected.
